name: Supported Image BaguetteBox Formatter
description: A baguetteBox.js lightbox formatter for Supported Image fields.
project_description:
Provides a field formatter that integrates Supported Image Field output with the baguetteBox.js lightbox.

 Features 
 Everything the baguetteBox.js module offers with the ability to use the Supported Image Field 's Caption and Attribution sub-fields as the baguetteBox.js caption source.

 Dependencies 
 
 Supported Image Field 
 baguetteBox.js 
 
 Post-installation 
 
 Go to the "Manage display" page of your entity type and change your supported image field's display formatter to "BaguetteBox". 
 Click the gear icon near the formatter to configure. 
 Save the display formatter settings. 
 
 Supporting this Module 
 You can support this module by helping out in our issue queue . Report bugs, feature requests, or other issues, and propose resolutions via merge requests or patches.
